title: Week 2026-W47 plan (baseline)
why: Baseline week, reviewed against testing standards: power before strength; hinge and squat rep-maxes on separate days (disc history); trunk-endurance and grip tests fresh on their own day; a pace-locked treadmill submax run instead of the 30-min TT after 4 weeks of no running; a 10-min bike for the engine (low back load, repeatable).
